topic_meaning: Multiple romantic interest vectors converge on the same identifiable recipient; a group alone is insufficient.

hard_topic_gates.criterion: At least two separately identifiable suitors direct personal romantic attention or invitations toward the same identifiable recipient in the actual pixels.

At least two vectors have mutually reinforcing relational cues such as personal invitation, absorbed gaze, tender expression or affiliative proximity; a generic group smile or service offer alone is insufficient.
The shared recipient visibly registers more than one converging offer through directed attention, suspended reach or reaction; the narrative cannot be supplied only by prose.
The suitors, shared target and carrying offer/attention connections remain visible together in one frame.

authorial_checks.criterion: A plausible ferry departure setting with a readable restrained future cue remains visible.
The recipient visibly resembles the portrait in short dark bob/fringe and facial impression at the available scale; exact identity is neither claimed nor tested.
Offer hands trace to their owners and separate objects; hands and faces remain inspectable.

interpretation_rules: Full pass requires every topic gate visible and supported. Partial evidence or author-imagined motive cannot pass a multi-component gate. Authorial checks are reported separately from topic meaning. Candidate exposure, permitted adoption, exact transport, pixels and user acceptance are separate outcomes. Pending user acceptance is not acceptance.
